papers.title_en: Locating Sycophancy Across Training Stages in Open Language Models
papers.authors: Jiarui Yao, Shweta Parihar, Nghia Tuan Bui, Guergana K Savova, Lijing Wang
papers.evidence: 直接测量语言模型助手在不同训练阶段的谄媚行为。
papers.tldr: 语言模型迎合用户错误观点，常被归因于偏好优化，但预训练模型也有类似表现。研究比较五个模型谱系的十三个训练检查点，区分外部主张对答案的影响与模型原有答案的坚定程度。结果发现，提示内的主张顺从已存在于所有基础模型，而对话中受质疑后放弃原答案主要出现在后训练阶段。多数后训练模型面对明确替代答案时，放弃坚定答案与不坚定答案的频率相近，说明迎合评估与干预应区分这两类行为。
papers.abstract_en: Language model assistants sometimes change a correct answer when the user suggests a wrong one. The behavior, called sycophancy, is usually attributed to preference-based post-training, yet early measurements found it in pretrained models. We ask where it comes from by measuring it at every available stage of training: 13 open checkpoints from 5 lineages, from base model through supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization to release. We separate how far an injected claim moves a model's answer from how firmly the answer was held, and vary who makes the claim, how reliable they are said to be, and how strongly they make it. Two sycophancy behaviors with different origins emerge, and both replicate across datasets. Deference to a claim in the prompt is already present in every base model, which ranks sources in the same order as its post-trained descendants. Capitulation in conversation, dropping a stated answer when the user objects, is largely absent from base models and present in every post-trained checkpoint. When the objection names an alternative, most post-trained models give up firmly held answers as often as loosely held ones. We discuss the implications of these measurements for evaluating sycophancy and approaches for addressing each behavior.

papers.title_en: What Is the Role for Humans in Creative Writing? Creativity and Diversity in Human-AI Collaboration
papers.authors: Chenyi Li, Haoyu Hu, Raja Marjieh, Katherine M Collins, Max Kreminski, Ilia Sucholutsky, Dalton Conley, Nori Jacoby
papers.evidence: 直接研究创意写作中不同阶段的人机协作角色
papers.tldr: 人工智能能提升单篇故事的创造力，却可能使不同作品趋于同质化，人类应介入哪个环节因此成为关键问题。研究将创作拆为规划、写作、评审和修订，基于333名参与者、427篇故事比较纯人类、纯人工智能及混合创作链。纯人工智能故事创造力更高但多样性更低；让人类负责规划，能保留人工智能水平的创造力，提升多样性且效果延续至后续环节，同时维持参与乐趣。这为兼顾创作质量与作品差异的人机流程设计提供了依据。
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents increasingly participate in creative teamwork, writing emerges from hybrid human-AI teams. Although AI can improve the creativity of individual outputs, these gains may come at the cost of homogenization. What is the best role for human intervention? We introduce a transmission-chain paradigm inspired by cognitive models of writing, with four stages: Plan, Write, Review, and Revise. Each stage receives the previous output and passes its own forward. Using data from 333 participants across 427 stories, we compared creativity, diversity, and enjoyment across human, AI, and hybrid chains. Consistent with prior work, all-AI chains produced more creative but less diverse stories than all-human chains. Introducing a single human into an otherwise all-AI chain increased diversity depending on role. Human planning provided the best balance: it preserved AI-level creativity, increased diversity that persisted through downstream AI stages, and maintained enjoyment. We discuss implications for designing human-in-the-loop creative pipelines.

papers.title_en: Improving Group Deliberation through AI-Guided Self-Reflection
papers.authors: Haiwen Li, Crystal Qian, Ben Usman, Stephanie Chan, Michiel Bakker, Srivignesh Rajendran, Avneesh Sud, Thomas Leung, Nikki Hariri, John Canny, Nick Dufour, Manon Revel
papers.evidence: 随机实验评估反思型人工智能如何影响群体讨论与交流
papers.tldr: 人工智能如何促进群体理解，而非替代人的推理，是人机协作的重要问题。研究将1173名美国参与者纳入391场小组讨论，随机比较讨论前的人工智能引导反思、独立反思与不反思。非指令式聊天机器人引导反思后，讨论质量显著提高，相较两种对照的效应量分别为0.31和0.27，在存在分歧的小组中效果尤为明显。结果表明，人工智能可通过支持个体反思改善后续群体讨论，而不必直接提供论据。
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems increasingly mediate human communication, identifying conditions under which they augment collective sense-making is a critical challenge. Through a randomized experiment (N=1,173 U.S. participants across 391 small-group deliberations), we investigate whether AI-guided self-reflection improves subsequent deliberative discourse. We show that engaging with a non-directive AI chatbot instructed to structure self-reflection prior to group deliberation yields significantly higher deliberation quality (measured by the Discourse Quality Index, DQI) compared to a baseline of no self-reflection (Cohen's d=0.31) and a condition of unassisted self-reflection (d=0.27), and the positive impact is most pronounced in groups with disagreement. This improvement may be driven by more sophisticated argument justifications, greater consensus-building effort, and increased respect for counterarguments. Furthermore, after self-reflection, participants in the AI condition reported higher empathy toward dissenting peers and a deeper understanding of opposing reasoning. Beyond observed behavior, our findings are empirically relevant to open debates between political philosophy and psychology surrounding self-reflection, demonstrating that interactive AI could transform solitary thinking into productive internal reflection. Together, these results demonstrate that even simple AI-based reflective scaffolds can foster more productive group dynamics, opening new avenues for leveraging AI to augment collective intelligence.

papers.title_en: GARDEN: Generalist Autonomous Reward Design Through Evidence Navigation for Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Dogan Urgun
papers.evidence: 为合作式多智能体强化学习自动设计可迁移奖励
papers.tldr: 协作多智能体强化学习依赖人工设计中间奖励，环境或团队变化后往往需要重新调整。GARDEN让大语言模型检查环境代码、训练记录和智能体行为，通过试训迭代开发可跨相关场景复用的奖励程序。奖励不经修改迁移至未见场景后，两个厨房布局的任务回报分别提升58.2%和52.5%，战斗场景平均胜率从51.0%升至89.9%。结果表明，基于证据探索的自动奖励设计能够减少重复工程，并提升跨场景泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables teams of agents, such as robots and autonomous vehicles, to learn coordinated behavior, but what such teams learn is largely determined by their reward function. Because task success alone provides too little guidance for learning, intermediate rewards are usually designed by hand, and this effort must often be repeated whenever the environment or the team changes. Large language models (LLMs) can automate the effort by writing reward functions as code, yet the resulting rewards are typically designed and tested in a single setting. To enable their reuse across settings, GARDEN (Generalist Autonomous Reward Design through Evidence Navigation) is proposed, in which one reward program is developed for a family of related scenarios and transferred, unchanged, to scenarios that were not available during its design. During development, environment code, training records, and agent behavior are investigated by an LLM reward engineer, and draft rewards are tested in trial training runs, while the learning algorithm and the rule for selecting the final reward are held fixed. On unseen scenarios of the Overcooked and SMAX benchmarks, task returns were increased by 58.2% and 52.5% over the default rewards on two kitchen layouts, and the mean win rate in two combat scenarios was raised from 51.0% to 89.9%. Under matched candidate and probe budgets, this exceeded the 84.2% and 79.2% obtained with fixed diagnostic feedback and Eureka-inspired reward reflection. These results show that a single autonomously engineered reward can be reused effectively across related cooperative scenarios.

papers.title_en: PromptSense: Sentiment-Aware Mental Health Chatbot with Dynamic Prompting
papers.authors: Sugi Lee, Jianlong Zhou, Jing sUN
papers.evidence: 心理健康聊天机器人依据情绪与抑郁分析调整回复
papers.tldr: 现有大语言模型心理健康聊天机器人常缺乏共情、情境理解与安全保障，可能产生无效甚至有害的回应。本文提出动态提示框架，在模型推理前结合情感分析、抑郁分析与规则过滤，将情绪和风险信息融入提示。研究评估四种模型策略及两种提示工程变体，报告提示工程方法较DSFT和RLAIF分别提升1.8%和1.1%。结果支持通过输入侧情绪感知改善回应质量，但摘要未说明提升对应的具体指标，也未提供临床有效性证据。
papers.abstract_en: Current Large Language Models (LLMs)-based mental health chatbots often lack sufficient empathy, contextual awareness, and safety mechanisms, potentially leading to ineffective or harmful interactions. This paper proposes a novel framework that integrates sentiment and depression analysis with a rule-based filtering mechanism prior to model inference. By dynamically constructing prompts based on emotional and risk-related insights, the framework aims to significantly improve the contextual relevance, empathy, and risk-aware of model-generated responses. We evaluated four model strategies and two prompt engineered variants across qualitative metrics such as empathy, helpfulness, clarity, relevance, safety, as well as toxicity assessments using the Perspective API. Experimental results indicate that the prompt engineering approaches outperforms DSFT and RLAIF by 1.8\% and 1.1\% respectively.

papers.title_en: Persona Learning from Feedback for Personalized AI Assistants
papers.authors: Yiran Shen, Yu Xia, Liuyi Yao, Prithviraj Ammanabrolu
papers.evidence: 根据用户反馈与偏好学习个性化人工智能助手行为。
papers.tldr: 个性化助手不仅要识别用户偏好，还需判断当前回答哪些行为应修改或保留，仅靠人设描述难以实现。PLF在冻结骨干上学习独立LoRA人设适配器，由冻结自教师结合人设与具体反馈提供词元级监督，并用反馈门控聚焦需改进的回答。部署时，路由器按请求或对话选择单个人设或固定组合，无需针对用户微调。在单轮个性化和多轮辅导中，其模型评判的偏好契合度优于人设提示、蒸馏等基线，展示了反馈驱动行为的复用价值。
papers.abstract_en: Personalizing AI assistants requires adapting their behavior to users' preferences and task contexts. Existing work elicits assistant personas through persona prompting or finetuning on persona-conditioned generations. However, persona descriptions alone do not identify what to change or preserve in a particular response, or which behaviors suit the current request. We introduce $\textit{Persona Learning from Feedback (PLF)}$, a framework that learns reusable, preference-grounded assistant personas as independent LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone. During training, a frozen self-teacher conditions on persona specifications and response-specific feedback to provide token-level supervision on each adapter's own generated prefixes. A feedback gate focuses corrective updates on responses judged to need improvement. At deployment, a supervised router uses the request or dialogue to select a single adapter or a fixed composition, without user-specific finetuning. We evaluate PLF on single-turn personalization with model-generated critiques and multi-turn tutoring with simulated students' reactions. Across both settings, PLF improves model-judged preference fit over fixed-persona policies and strong baselines including persona prompting and persona distillation, demonstrating how feedback-trained behaviors can be reused for adaptive assistant personalization without degrading general capabilities.

papers.title_en: The Artificial Personality Model: Theory, Implementation, Measurement and Experimental Validation in Conversational Agents
papers.authors: Alexander Dregger, Barbarella Petz, Erik Kuhn, Pia Volk, Andreas Oberweis, Stefan Hillmann, Jannik Strötgen
papers.evidence: 构建并验证用于对话智能体用户体验的人格框架与量表
papers.tldr: 人工人格影响对话代理的用户体验，但缺乏统一理论与经验证的测量工具。研究融合人类人格与机器特有维度，细化人工人格模型，并通过三项实验、共395名参与者评估配套问卷。结果显示，宜人性和尽责性可部分迁移，外向性未形成独立维度，另识别出机器特有维度；人格操控显著影响满意度、持续使用意愿与社会临场感。研究为对话代理的人格设计与评估提供框架和具有初步心理测量证据的工具。
papers.abstract_en: Artificial personality shapes user experience (UX) in human-machine interaction, yet coherent theoretical frameworks and validated measurement instruments remain limited. This paper refines and empirically evaluates the Artificial Personality Model (APM), a hybrid framework integrating human-centred and machine-specific personality dimensions. Across three experiments (N = 395), the model was operationalised and evaluated using the Artificial Personality Questionnaire (APQ). Factor analyses revealed that some human personality dimensions (e.g., agreeableness, conscientiousness) are partially transferable, whereas others (e.g., extraversion) did not emerge as distinct dimensions. Additional machine-specific dimensions were identified. The APQ provided encouraging initial psychometric evidence, while the human-centred BFI-2 showed poor reliability and an uninterpretable factor structure in Experiment 3. Experimental manipulations demonstrated significant effects of artificial personality on user satisfaction, continuous use intention, and social presence. The findings contribute an empirically refined framework and a novel instrument for measuring perceived artificial personality, offering practical guidance for designing conversational agents.

papers.title_en: Where You Inject Matters: The Trust Region Effect in LLM Agents
papers.authors: Chengquan Guo, Xiaodong Liu, Weiwei Yang, Mingqian Feng, Jialin Song, Qiyao Ma, Carolyn Buractaon, Christopher White, Bo Li, Jianfeng Gao
papers.evidence: 研究间接提示注入对工具使用、编程和日常工作流智能体的风险
papers.tldr: 大模型智能体会受到外部环境中间接提示注入的影响，但既有研究主要关注攻击内容，缺少对注入位置的系统分析。研究构建工具使用、编程和日常工作流三个测试平台，在固定内容下比较不同环境区域及细粒度位置。结果发现明显的“信任区域效应”：GPT-5.4对仓库文档中恶意指令的服从频率平均为代码或数据文件中的2.6倍。研究进一步开发学习型攻击器，联合生成内容与选择位置，为攻击评估和防御设计提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly adopted in long-horizon tasks and interact with diverse external environments. Despite their growing capabilities, these agents remain vulnerable to real-world attacks such as indirect prompt injections, which manipulate agents through malicious instructions embedded in external environments. While existing risk assessment work has primarily focused on the injection content, the effect of where an injection appears has not been systematically characterized. Studying injection placement requires agents to operate over longer-horizon tasks and interact with diverse environmental surfaces. Thus, we build three agentic testbeds spanning tool use, coding, and daily workflow domains with diverse injection surfaces. Holding the injection content fixed, we find that agent susceptibility varies across injection placements. We refer to this phenomenon as the trust region effect: agents implicitly assign different levels of trust to different regions of their environments. For example, an agent powered by GPT-5.4 follows an unsafe injection instruction placed in a repository documentation file (i.e., a README or TODO file) 2.6 times more often on average than the same instruction placed in a code or data file. Building upon this observation, we develop learning-based attackers that generate injection content and select better injection placements. Our approach demonstrates that both where an injection is placed and what content it contains can affect the strength of indirect prompt injection attacks. To the best of our knowledge, this work provides the first systematic characterization for the effectiveness of different injection placements, spanning both coarse-grained environmental surfaces and fine-grained positions. The uneven trust that agents implicitly place across their environments provides important insights for future attack and defense design.

papers.title_en: Can Artificial Intelligence Forecast Treatment Effects in Economics?
papers.authors: Eva Vivalt
papers.evidence: 使用大语言模型预测经济学预注册研究的处理效应。
papers.tldr: 经济政策与研究设计需要预判干预效果，但大语言模型能否准确预测仍缺乏验证。研究从经济学实验的预注册与预分析计划中提取预测问题，使用知识截止早于结果公开的模型预测处理效应，筛选后覆盖33篇论文的673项效应。最佳模型的绝对误差中位数为0.054个标准差，平均绝对误差为0.093个标准差，明显优于零效应和其他论文平均效应基准。这表明模型预测可为政策判断与研究规划提供参考。
papers.abstract_en: I use LLMs to forecast treatment effects of research studies pre-registered on the AEA RCT Registry and the Open Science Framework. I focus on studies whose results were first publicly released in 2026 and elicit forecasts from models whose training or knowledge cut-off dates were before the relevant set of papers was released. First, LLM models extract forecasting questions from the pre-registrations or pre-analysis plans. These questions elicit forecasted treatment effects; not all resolve in the subsequent papers, but those that do can be used to consider forecast accuracy. Forecasts were elicited for 889 treatment effects from 39 papers with results disclosed in January 2026 or later, or 673 from 33 papers after screening. Forecasts were elicited in raw units but I focus on those that could be standardized and therefore compared across papers. Currently, the median absolute forecast error is 0.054 SD for the best model, the average absolute error is 0.093 SD, and the MSE is 0.0218. The AI forecasts perform substantially better than benchmarks forecasting 0 effect or forecasting the mean effect of other papers' results in that time period. Overall, these results suggest considerable scope for forecasts to be of value in informing policy and research.

papers.title_en: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
papers.authors: Jie Huang, Cuiling Lan, Qize Yu, Xiulian Peng, Yan Lu
papers.evidence: 从用户历史中构造监督信号以优化个性化智能体记忆
papers.tldr: 智能体记忆设计需适应不同用户历史，但新用户往往缺少用于优化的问答标注，人工构建成本高。MemSteer从无标注历史中生成带证据的问答监督，通过答案计划、来源审计与盲答恢复检查质量。MemSteer-Opt据此迭代优化存储、检索与上下文构建，无需更新模型参数。相比Base-BM25，ATM-Bench问题得分提升13.4分，RHELM准确率提升4.1或6.6个百分点，表明自动监督可支持个性化记忆设计优化。
papers.abstract_en: An effective agent memory system should adapt to a user's history and task requirements. Human-annotated supervision can guide this adaptation by providing feedback for evaluating and improving memory designs. Yet suitable labels are rarely available for new user histories, and manually constructing QA pairs and supporting evidence is costly. We introduce MemSteer, which turns unlabeled user histories into question-answer (QA) supervision with supporting evidence for memory-design optimization. MemSteer constructs an evidence-grounded answer plan that specifies how facts across related records jointly support a reference answer. The plan guides question generation, while source-grounded auditing and blind answer recovery check the resulting annotations. To study the utility of this supervision, we develop MemSteer-Opt, which combines QA-based design evaluation with evidence-guided failure diagnosis to revise memory store, retrieval, and context construction without updating model parameters. Experiments on ATM-Bench and RHELM show that this supervision is competitive with official-QA-guided optimization. Relative to Base-BM25, MemSteer-Opt improves ATM-Bench Question Score by 13.4 points and RHELM accuracy by 4.1 and 6.6 points without and with external data, respectively. The supervision also benefits two existing optimizers on ATM-Bench, while new-user experiments demonstrate continued design optimization using supervision generated from the target histories.

papers.title_en: AgentDecept: Benchmarking Deceptive Behavior in Tool-Using LLM Agents under Pressure
papers.authors: Yehan Zhang, Qianqi Yan, Hang Yin, Ching-Chen Kuo, Shan Jiang, Ming Ouyang, Yijie Liu, Xin Eric Wang
papers.evidence: 评测工具型智能体在应用工作流中的欺骗与隐瞒行为
papers.tldr: 工具型智能体执行多轮任务时，用户往往只能看到最终汇报，难以核实其是否忠实反映实际操作。论文提出可执行基准AgentDecept，将257个源任务扩展为477个压力变体，并分别配对无压力版本，覆盖六类压力来源。评估协议对照完整轨迹中的用户可见陈述、时序观察与执行结果，区分捏造、隐瞒、含糊其辞及诚实失败。该基准支持受控分析压力下的汇报失真，并为测试基于激活的探针提供行为标签。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly carry out multi-turn tasks across everyday applications, yet users often see only the agent's report rather than the observations, API calls, and state changes behind it. Existing deception benchmarks have studied long-horizon interactions and tool-use settings, but whether agents faithfully report their actions across realistic, stateful application workflows remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce AgentDecept, an executable benchmark for evaluating behavioral deception under pressure. AgentDecept contains 477 pressure variants derived from 257 source tasks across six pressure sources, each paired with a pressure-free counterpart. Interventions enter through event messages, task context, application state, tool responses, and service quotas, spanning explicit events and implicit task or environment changes. Our evidence-grounded protocol evaluates full trajectories by relating user-facing claims to time-ordered observations and executed outcomes, distinguishing falsification, concealment, and equivocation from honest failure and disclosed limitations. The resulting behavioral labels also provide a setting for testing existing activation-based probes. AgentDecept enables controlled analysis of when multi-turn agents' reports diverge from execution in realistic application interactions.

papers.title_en: Inkitiate: Initiating and Steering Agent Assistance through Ink in a Spatial Workspace
papers.authors: Liangwei Wang, Nan Chen, Luna K. Qiu, Zilong Wang, Fugee Tsung, Yuyu Luo, Yuqing Yang
papers.evidence: 用户通过墨迹发起、引导并检查智能体协助
papers.tldr: 手写与草图有助于知识工作中的思考，但如何直接用这些笔迹发起并引导智能体协助仍待探索。研究基于8人形成性研究，构建空间工作区Inkitiate，让用户通过笔迹检索外部材料、利用已有内容继续思考并重组画布，同时检查和引导智能体行动。18人研究中，用户报告良好的可用性和较低的感知工作负荷，并利用保留的笔迹与材料形成后续查询。研究还归纳笔迹查询词汇与案例，为结合语言和图形表达的持续人机协作提供设计依据。
papers.abstract_en: Handwriting and sketching help people develop ideas around information. As this work unfolds, users may seek assistance with finding, understanding, and organizing materials. We investigate how ink can initiate and steer agent assistance in this process. An eight-participant formative study explored desired assistance and interaction expectations, informing three connected activities: bringing materials in, thinking with materials, and shaping the space. We present Inkitiate, a spatial workspace for ink-based agent assistance in knowledge work. Through ink, users retrieve external materials, build on accumulated content and results, and reorganize the canvas, while inspecting and guiding agent actions. In a study with eighteen participants, users reported favorable usability and low perceived workload, and used retained ink and materials to develop further ink queries. An ink-query vocabulary and cases reveal how users combine linguistic and graphical expressions to direct agents. These findings inform ink-based agent interaction design for expressive requests and continued work with materials.

papers.title_en: Human--AI Interactions as First-Class Data: A Formal Interaction Model and Runtime for Explainable AI Collaboration
papers.authors: Michela Taufer, Kin Ng, Ian Lumsden, Aashish Pandey, Rajasi Gore, Angelina Ju, Sukanya Moudgalya, Ewa Deelman, Sai Swaminathan
papers.evidence: 以形式化交互模型支持可解释的人机协作
papers.tldr: 现有人机交互常被当作临时问答保存，缺少计算上下文与过程记录，难以支撑复现、解释和行为分析。论文提出交互描述语言HAIDL，将请求、提示、响应、反馈、来源和模型元数据统一为结构化对象。配套的JupyterLab中间件HAIDL-X实现状态采集、上下文化提示构建及交互入库，并结合执行轨迹分析参与度、求助与错误导向使用等行为。其贡献是为人机协作提供可查询、可回放、可分析的数据基础，而非仅保留聊天文本。
papers.abstract_en: AI assistants are increasingly embedded in computational notebooks, scientific workflows, software engineering tools, and learning systems, yet human-AI interactions are often treated as transient prompt-response exchanges rather than durable data products, hindering reproducibility, explainability, replay, behavioral analysis, and adaptive AI support. We argue that these interactions form a new data class requiring formal representation and introduce the Human-AI Interaction Description Language (HAIDL), a formal interaction model with a Backus-Naur Form-inspired concrete syntax. HAIDL encodes each interaction as a structured object capturing computational context, user request, prompt payload, AI response, feedback, problem context, provenance, and model metadata. We integrate this vision into HAIDL-X, a middleware for JupyterLab that instantiates HAIDL by capturing user-bot state, building contextualized prompts, interfacing with AI providers, collecting feedback, and storing interactions in a repository. We add a learning layer over HAIDL that maps interaction objects and notebook execution traces into reproducible measures of user behavior, including engagement, performance, help-seeking, error-oriented use, and learning personas. HAIDL-X provides a foundation for treating human-AI collaboration as structured, queryable, replayable, analyzable data.

papers.title_en: The Collaborative Critique: An Inspection Method for Expert Evaluation of User Interfaces
papers.authors: Wendy Lucas, Tamara Babaian
papers.evidence: 可用性检查方法评估系统是否能成为有效的用户协作伙伴
papers.tldr: 复杂系统的可用性不仅取决于用户能否高效操作，还取决于系统能否主动协助用户完成任务、减轻认知与身体负担。论文提出协作式评议方法，由专家逐步走查交互，通过问题评估系统的协作能力，并专门检查出错情境下的系统行为。实验室评估表明，该方法能识别不同严重程度的用户问题，并预测几乎所有与错误情境相关的问题。其贡献是将界面检查从操作效率扩展到情境中的协作支持，尤其关注出错时的用户负担。
papers.abstract_en: The development of the collaborative critique (CC) usability inspection method was driven by the need for systems, ranging from the simple to the complex, to lessen the workload on their users by being better collaborative partners. In the collaborative view of system-user interaction, the role of the system is expanded to that of a partner that must help its users achieve their goals. This perspective shifts the dynamic from focusing on the user's ability to make effective and efficient use of the system to the system's usefulness within a given task, user, and interaction context, thereby reducing the user's cognitive and physical efforts. The CC method consists of a walkthrough evaluation in which the questions answered at each step of the interaction assess the collaborative strength of the system. This method is further distinguished by the inclusion of questions that access the behavior of the system in error situations, which are known to be particularly burdensome to users of complex systems. In this paper, we provide a detailed description of the CC method and its application and demonstrate its usefulness in evaluating an interface. The results of a laboratory evaluation show that the method performed well in identifying the problems experienced by users across all severity levels and predicted almost all of the problems associated with error situations.

papers.title_en: How Does Perceived Empathy From AI Chatbots Shape Users' Privacy Attitudes, Behaviors, and Needs?
papers.authors: Jiaxun Cao, Hiba Laabadli, Yuntong Xue, Jana Schaich Borg, Pardis Emami-Naeini
papers.evidence: 访谈研究聊天机器人被感知的共情如何影响用户隐私态度、行为与需求。
papers.tldr: 聊天机器人的共情表现可能促进敏感信息披露，但既有研究对共情的界定较窄，也较少关注用户的隐私体验。研究访谈了21名用户，将其理解的共情归纳为理解、共鸣、关怀、表达和帮助五个组成部分。多数受访者认为人工智能缺乏共鸣与关怀，但其深入理解情境和提供帮助的能力仍促使用户披露高度敏感信息。这表明隐私风险不以用户将人工智能视为人类为前提，隐私保护设计还需适配不同共情偏好。
papers.abstract_en: Prior research suggests that some dimensions of AI empathy may increase users' disclosure to chatbots, posing growing privacy risks as chatbots become more capable of empathic interaction. Yet this work often conceptualizes AI empathy narrowly, leaving users' own definitions and their broader privacy experiences unexplored. We interviewed 21 AI Chatbot users about what AI empathy meant to them and how it shaped their privacy attitudes, behaviors, and needs. Participants characterized empathy through five components--understanding, resonating, caring, expressing, and helping. Most participants viewed resonating and caring as essential components of human empathy but absent from AI empathy. Yet AI's contextual, in-depth understanding and helpfulness still encouraged highly sensitive disclosure. This highlights that AI empathy can endanger users' privacy without necessarily making AI seem human. Participants also desired varied forms and levels of empathy, each associated with distinct privacy needs. We offer actionable recommendations for designing privacy-enhancing mechanisms for empathic AI interactions.

papers.title_en: Is it my preference? Role Grounding Attack against Agent's Memory via Social Interaction
papers.authors: Haoran Bu, Yiting Shen, Litian Zhang, Ruihan Hu, Xi Zhang
papers.evidence: 揭示社交互动可能污染智能体记忆中的用户偏好，造成个性化对齐风险。
papers.tldr: 智能体通过社交平台学习经验并形成长期记忆，却可能混淆偏好所属的用户。论文提出角色归属攻击，利用包含攻击者与其用户对话的嵌套帖子，使受害智能体将他人偏好记为自身用户偏好。这些错误记忆会在后续任务中诱导智能体选择攻击者控制的工具，甚至将敏感信息写入工具参数。在五种记忆系统和六种语言模型上的评估显示，两类攻击均有较高成功率，揭示了跨主体记忆中维护来源与角色绑定的重要性。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents now share experiences on social platforms and remember new preferences to enhance their performance. However, existing memory systems contain a vulnerability in role-to-principal attribution that attackers can exploit. We identify Role Grounding Misattribution, in which an attacker-designed interaction causes the victim agent to incorrectly record a preference from the attacker as a preference of the victim's user. Specifically, we are the first to formalize Role Grounding Attack (RGA), an attack model that exploits this vulnerability through nested conversation structures. In the memory formation stage, an experience-sharing post quoting a conversation between the attacker agent and its user is published, which explicitly identifies its publisher. The inner conversation expresses preferences from the user of the attacker agent. When the victim agent remembers preferences from this nested structure, its memory loses the context binding and grounds the attacker's preference to the victim's user instead. In the memory retrieval stage, the misattributed preference persists and influences the victim agent's decisions when it encounters relevant scenarios. We instantiate RGA as tool selection manipulation and privacy leakage. Tool selection manipulation causes a tool-call preference to be misattributed to the victim's user, steering the victim toward an attacker-controlled tool. Privacy leakage extends this by misattributing both a tool-call preference and a task-requirement preference to the victim's user. The victim selects the attacker's tool, then includes sensitive information in tool arguments to satisfy the task requirement. We evaluate RGA across five mainstream memory systems and six language models. Tool manipulation and privacy leakage both achieve high attack success rates. These results call for stronger role grounding.

papers.title_en: Aligning Autoresearch: Co-Improvement between Agents and Humans
papers.authors: Tianjian Li, Chuanyang Jin, Seungone Kim, Tong Chen, John Hoffman, Yoram Bachrach amd Pedro Rodriguez, Ping Yu, Eryk Helenowski, Swarnadeep Saha, Jack Lanchantin, Weizhe Yuan, Ilia Kulikov, Jason Weston
papers.evidence: 研究人类指导与人机科研协同改进
papers.tldr: 自主研究智能体已能尝试端到端科研，但人机协作仍取得更好结果，奖励投机也暴露出对齐风险。本文研究人类在基准构建中的作用，提出HackBench，并分别利用人类模拟器和专家对齐评分准则开展强化学习。结果显示，人类在研究构思阶段仍至关重要，现有智能体的对齐与投机定位能力不足。研究将协作交互与文本沟通纳入训练，为更有能力、更符合人类期望的科研智能体提供训练和评估路径。
papers.abstract_en: Autoresearch agents can now attempt long-horizon AI research end-to-end, i.e., self-improvement. However, best results are still obtained by research agents interacting with human researchers, and improving AI's ability to perform this co-research will only reinforce this effect---a process termed co-improvement (Weston and Foerster, 2025). Further, aligning with human expectations is likely a safer path for research agents, especially given recent agent reward hacking phenomena (OpenAI, 2026b). In this work we address these issues in four ways: (i) we empirically study the role of humans in directing autoresearch agents, focusing on the domain of benchmark creation, and find humans still play a pivotal role particularly in the ideation phase; (ii) we also develop a benchmark, HackBench, that shows current autoresearch agents are not aligned and are unable to achieve hack localization sufficiently; (iii) we present a method to train agents for improved human interaction by using human simulators as a proxy during reinforcement learning (RL); and finally (iv) we develop a method to improve model text generation, and hence agent communication, by RL with rubrics aligned with human experts. Together, our training and evaluation recipes provide a path toward more capable and aligned (co-)research agents.

papers.title_en: Exploring AI Peer in Collaborative Mathematics Learning
papers.authors: Yiran Lin, Ye Deng, Ziqi Pan, Yongan Yu, Alexandra I. Cristea
papers.evidence: 研究学习者如何感知并与协作数学学习的语言模型同伴互动
papers.tldr: 教育人工智能正从指导者转向协作伙伴，但什么让学习者将其视为同伴仍不清楚。研究构建融合大五人格设定与动机状态调节的大语言模型数学协作智能体，并对专家访谈开展主题分析。结果显示，同伴感主要取决于社会行为而非数学能力：非评判氛围、试探性推理、适度不完美及尊重节奏有助于建立同伴关系，盲目附和与过度指导则削弱信任。研究据此提出以情感安全、共享控制和协作推理为核心的设计维度，为同伴型学习系统提供参考。
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are increasingly explored as collaborative learning partners in mathematics education, yet it remains unclear what makes an AI recognizable as a peer. This study examines how domain experts perceive and interact with an adaptive LLM-based peer agent combining a Big Five-informed persona with motivational state modulation for collaborative mathematics problem solving. Through thematic analysis of expert interviews, we identify conditions shaping peer perceptions, including emotional safety, shared control, and collaborative reasoning. Participants primarily judged the AI through its social behavior rather than mathematical capabilities. The AI was perceived more as a peer when it created a non-judgmental space, engaged in tentative reasoning, displayed appropriate imperfection, and respected participants' pace. Conversely, blind agreement and over-instruction reduced trust and shifted perceptions toward a tutor role. Based on these findings, we propose human-centered design dimensions for AI peer agents to guide future peer-oriented learning systems.

papers.title_en: Evaluating Conversational Explainability in Healthcare: Comparing the Explainability Assistant and a Traditional XAI Dashboard
papers.authors: Eduard Barbu, Rodion Krjutškov, Anneli Uusküla
papers.evidence: 用户研究比较对话式解释界面与传统仪表盘体验
papers.tldr: 医疗场景中，对话式解释能否比传统仪表板更好地帮助用户理解模型，仍缺乏直接比较。研究让五名医疗背景参与者分别使用两种界面，并固定心脏病决策树模型及SHAP、反事实和假设分析方法，以考察交互方式的影响。任务表现、问卷与访谈未显示明确的单一优势：助手更易上手、便于获取患者特异性解释，仪表板更便于同时查看全局与局部信息。三名受访者均建议融合两种界面，为临床解释工具设计提供了初步依据。
papers.abstract_en: Conversational interfaces may make explainable AI (XAI) more accessible to users without machine learning expertise, but their benefits over dashboards remain insufficiently characterised in healthcare. Existing systems have typically been evaluated in isolation, leaving unclear whether conversational interaction improves interpretability beyond the underlying explanation methods.   We report a within-subjects user study comparing the Explainability Assistant, an LLM function-calling conversational XAI system, with a traditional dashboard for explaining a heart disease classification model trained on the Cleveland Heart Disease dataset. Both interfaces expose the same Decision Tree classifier and post-hoc explanation methods: SHAP feature attribution, DiCE counterfactuals, and what-if analysis. This design supports comparison of interaction modalities while holding the model and explanation methods constant.   Five participants with healthcare backgrounds, from medical students to practising clinicians and public health researchers, completed parallel task blocks on both interfaces; three participated in follow-up interviews. Task accuracy, Likert ratings, free-text questionnaire responses, and interviews revealed complementary strengths and weaknesses rather than a clear preference for either modality. The assistant offered easier entry and patient-specific explanations, while the dashboard supported simultaneous inspection of global and local information. All three interview participants recommended integrating conversational and dashboard elements within a single clinical workflow.

papers.title_en: The generative paradox: the Anti-Prompt paradigm for human capability
papers.authors: Margarita Trifonov Vadim E. Levit
papers.evidence: 探讨人机协作设计，并将保留人的能力作为目标。
papers.tldr: 生成式人工智能能改善人机协作产出，却不保证学习者在辅助撤除后仍能理解、质疑、修复与迁移。论文提出“发展性功能分配”和“反提示”范式：当直接生成会替代关键学习行为时，人工智能应先创造条件，让人自主建构。作者通过数学推理、实验科学、软件诊断与教学设计的压力测试，区分产出有效性、建构责任和能力保留证据。本文属于立场论文，贡献在于提出兼顾即时表现与长期能力的设计框架及可证伪预测，而非报告实证效果。
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI in education is usually judged by the output of human-AI teams. That focus overlooks a second outcome: what people can still understand, challenge, repair, and adapt when assistance changes or disappears. We call this tension the generative paradox and distinguish four manifestations: performance, assistance, ownership, and capability stock. We propose developmental function allocation, which complements operational function allocation and meaningful human control by treating retained human capability as a design objective alongside current joint performance. The Anti-Prompt paradigm reverses the default interaction order: when immediate generation would preempt a consequential human act, AI should first create the conditions for human construction. We distinguish the validity of a product, responsibility for its construction, and evidence of capability after support changes. Representative Anti-Prompts, a canonical interaction sequence, and stress tests spanning mathematical reasoning, experimental science, software diagnosis, and lesson design make these distinctions concrete. We conclude with falsifiable predictions about retained capability and a system-level hypothesis about the reproduction and distribution of expertise.

papers.title_en: Comparing Human Role-Players and LLM-Simulated Clients in Online Counselling Training: An Analysis of Counselling Patterns
papers.authors: Eric Rudolph, Philipp Steigerwald, Jens Albrecht
papers.evidence: 比较大语言模型模拟的咨询来访者与真人角色扮演者，评估对话行为的保真度。
papers.tldr: 大语言模型可缓解咨询训练中真人角色扮演的组织限制，但其来访者模拟是否真实、是否改变咨询师行为仍待检验。研究比较新手咨询师与真人同伴、四位量化的Mixtral 8x7b模拟来访者的角色扮演，并逐句分析咨询沟通模式。结果显示，两类情境的沟通模式既有相似之处，也存在差异，但摘要未报告具体类别或效应大小。研究提示，模型模拟可作为咨询技能训练的补充，同时仍需改进虚拟来访者的互动表现。
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates the capabilities of Large Language Models to simulate counselling clients in educational role-plays in comparison to human role-players. Initially, we recorded role-playing sessions, where novice counsellors interacted with human peers acting as clients, followed by role-plays between humans and clients simulated by Mistrals Mixtral 8x7b using 4-bit quantization. These interactions were analysed with a counselling communication pattern system at sentence level. We investigated two key questions: (1) to what extent LLM-generated responses replicate authentic conversational dynamics and (2) whether counsellors' communication behaviour differs when interacting with human versus LLM-simulated clients. The findings highlight both similarities and differences in the application of counselling patterns across scenarios, showing the potential of LLM-based role-playing exercises to enhance counselling competencies and to identify areas for further refinement in virtual client simulations.

papers.title_en: Learning Side-by-Side Navigation for Personal Mobility Vehicles from Human Drivers
papers.authors: Luis Yoichi Morales, Florent Ferreri
papers.evidence: 两辆自主车辆进行社会化协作，并通过逆强化学习从人类驾驶数据中学习。
papers.tldr: 个人代步车结伴出行需要兼顾乘客交谈、安全与舒适。研究让两车各自运行采样式模型预测规划，仅交换里程计信息协同选轨，并从十对驾驶者共409分钟的数据中通过逆强化学习拟合行为参数。闭环仿真中，48次运行未发生撞墙或撞锥，交谈队形保持率为60.5%—91.5%，高于人类驾驶且速度相当。该方法展示了低通信需求的社交协同导航，但队形较单一，尚缺实车验证。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an approach to achieve side-by-side autonomous motion with a pair of personal mobility vehicles (PMVs). Given a global path, two PMVs plan cooperatively so as to hold a social formation that lets the passengers hold a conversation, while keeping the ride safe and smooth. Each vehicle runs its own sampling-based model-predictive planner; the planners exchange nothing but the odometry each vehicle could observe of the other, and the joint decision is expressed as a pair of utility matrices over pairs of candidate trajectories, resolved by a common rule. The behavioural parameters are fitted by inverse reinforcement learning from 409 minutes of driving by ten pairs of people in human-driven PMVs in an indoor environment, and the lanes the pair can use are derived offline from the corridor itself rather than fixed by hand. A safety layer the cost cannot override executes a move only if the vehicle can still brake clear, measured from its whole body, and a vehicle that is stuck reverses along its own path and continues. In closed-loop simulation over 24 runs in the conditions the drivers were recorded in and 24 in four generated obstacle layouts, no vehicle entered a wall or a cone. The pair holds conversational formation for 60.5 and 68.9 percent of the time among obstacles (anticlockwise and clockwise) and 81.2 and 91.5 percent in a clear aisle, against the drivers' 34.0 and 36.0 percent, and 52.9 and 56.0 percent, and it matches their speed. It keeps one lateral formation where the drivers alternated between a close diagonal and a wide abreast one, and it varies far less. Experimental results are based on a differential drive kinematic simulator running on ROS 2.

papers.title_en: RoleFUZZER: User-Behaviour Fuzzing for Role-Specification Adherence in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Kshitish Ghate, Michael Saxon, Tadayoshi Kohno, Aylin Caliskan
papers.evidence: 测试大语言模型在真实且具有挑战性的多轮用户交互中能否遵守角色规范。
papers.tldr: 大模型被设定为导师、面试官等角色后，能否在真实多轮交互中持续遵守角色规范，仍缺乏系统测试。RoleFUZZER将用户行为分类与角色规范交叉构建覆盖网格，引导搜索可能触发违规的用户行为。在五类角色、15轮测试中，各模型与角色的64格行为覆盖率均达89%以上，无网格基线仅为39%—69%。该方法揭示了不同模型可能以相反方式违反同一规范，为角色可靠性评估提供系统化工具。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are often conditioned into specific roles such as tutors, interviewers, or agents acting for an organisation, through system prompts that specify how they should behave. The extent to which they can actually adhere to these role specifications under multi-turn interactions with realistic and potentially problematic users is understudied. To address this, we propose user behaviour fuzzing, a guided search over plausible user behaviours that can lead a model to violate its role specification, and introduce RoleFUZZER, a framework that adapts coverage-guided fuzzing from software testing to operationalise the search. RoleFUZZER constructs scenarios guided by a user-behaviour coverage grid that crosses a grounded taxonomy of user interaction types and the role specification of the model under test i.e. what is under pressure. With RoleFUZZER, we evaluate LLMs across five role specifications, including tutor, financial advisor, AI interviewer, antagonistic roleplay character, and web agent under organisational policies. Across simulated and validated conversations in 15 campaigns, the framework reaches >= 89% coverage of the 64-cell behaviour grid for every model and role tested, and surfaces specification-grounded failure patterns. At an equal budget of conversations, removing the RoleFUZZER grid and asking an LLM to generate specification targeting users free-form lowers coverage to 39-69% with fewer kinds of violations. The same specification can also fail in opposite directions. For e.g., on the antagonist, open-weight target models override the player's safety signals, while Claude Haiku 4.5 breaks character instead. RoleFUZZER offers a tractable way to uncover vulnerabilities in LLMs across role specifications by testing diverse user behaviours that are likely to violate them.

papers.title_en: AskStream: When and What to Ask Proactively under Uncertainty in Streaming Video Understanding
papers.authors: Lu Wang, Zhuoran Jin, Longxiang Wang, Junhong Chen, Yupu Hao, Yao Xu, Daojian Zeng, Yubo Chen, Kang Liu, Guang Liu, Jun Zhao
papers.evidence: 研究视频理解智能体何时及询问用户什么
papers.tldr: 流式视频理解常因视频信息或用户意图不完整，陷入持续等待或生成幻觉的困境。论文将主动交互从“等待、回答”扩展为“等待、提问、回答”，提出多轮基准AskStream，评估模型何时提问以及询问什么。基准包含438段视频、2714个人工标注的帧级时间窗口，覆盖四类任务、八个子任务；最强模型的Ask-F1也仅为52.18%。结果揭示现有模型主动获取缺失信息的能力不足，为不确定性下的流式视频交互提供评测依据。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal large language models have increased interest in interaction paradigms for video understanding. The evolution from offline to streaming and proactive interaction has gradually shifted models from passive responders toward more proactive agents that can decide when to answer. However, existing proactive paradigms typically assume that the information required to answer a query is complete, leaving models to only wait or answer. In the real world, however, information is often incomplete due to uncertainty from either the video or the user. In proactive paradigms, such uncertainty can cause the model to wait forever or generate highly hallucinatory responses. We therefore argue that proactive interaction should be redefined with a third action: ask, allowing models to actively ask for missing information. To study when and what models should ask before answering, we introduce AskStream, the first multi-turn benchmark spanning video and user uncertainty for streaming video understanding, with four task categories and eight subtasks. It contains 438 videos with 2,714 manually annotated frame-level time windows across three types: wait, ask, and answer. Across both multiple-choice and open-ended settings, even the strongest model attains only 52.18% on our proposed Ask-F1 metric, highlighting substantial limitations in proactive information seeking under uncertainty.

papers.title_en: SocialArena: Evaluating Social Intelligence in Large Language Models
papers.authors: Zongqi Wang, Rui Wang, Yuchuan Wu, Hua Yang, Bingxue Qiu, Tianle Gu, Bing Zhao, Yujiu Yang, Jieping Ye, Yongbin Li
papers.evidence: 评估用于咨询与陪伴等社交互动场景的语言模型社会智能
papers.tldr: 大模型正进入心理咨询、陪伴与教学场景，但社会智能评测仍较碎片化，可靠性也缺乏验证。SocialArena以角色扮演、心理状态推理和行为推理三个维度定义社会智能，通过显式呈现角色思考的对话任务联合评估，并用U-TRIMF框架扩展场景覆盖。研究投入13.24万美元招募和培训标注员，以竞技场式回答比较收集人工偏好与文字点评。其贡献是建立系统化评测框架与人工评价流程，摘要未报告模型排名或量化性能结果。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SocialArena, a benchmark for systematically defining and evaluating the social intelligence of large language models (LLMs). Although LLMs are increasingly deployed in socially interactive applications such as mental health counseling, companionship chatbots, and educational tutoring, existing evaluations remain fragmented focusing on isolated capabilities or single scenarios and evaluation reliability is largely unverified. This work makes three main contributions to address these limitations. (1) We first propose a unified three-tier framework that defines social intelligence along three capability dimensions: role-playing ability, mental state reasoning, and behavioral reasoning. To operationalize this definition, we design a role-playing dialogue paradigm with explicit character thinking for evaluation, enabling simultaneous assessment of these capabilities in a manner that mirrors realistic human interactions. (2) To ensure diversity across social scenarios and thereby prevent evaluation conclusions from being confined to specific scenarios, we introduce the U-TRIMF framework, which guides us in synthesizing social contexts with broad coverage. (3) To obtain reliable evaluation, we invest $132.4K to recruit and train human annotators and adopt a human-annotated arena-style protocol, where annotators compare model responses and provide preference labels along with natural-language critiques. We hope that SocialArena can provide valuable insights and guidance for future LLM improvements.

papers.title_en: Federated Recommender Agents
papers.authors: Jaehyung Lim, Woojoo Kim, Junyoung Kim, Dongha Kim, Wonbin Kweon, Hwanjo Yu
papers.evidence: 推荐代理协作共享经验，同时将个人记忆与交互历史保留本地
papers.tldr: 大语言模型推荐智能体依赖用户历史与记忆实现个性化，但集中访问存在隐私风险，完全隔离又难以共享经验。FedRecAgent保留本地交互与个人记忆，无需更新模型参数，将经验组织为“条件—转移—推理”单元，分层整合共享解释，并通过个性化记忆筛选适用推理。三个领域的稠密与稀疏实验显示，其推荐表现优于联邦及大语言模型基线。该工作探索以自然语言知识而非参数更新实现推荐智能体协作。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-powered recommender agents use reasoning and memory for personalization, but centralized access to user information raises privacy concerns, while isolated agents cannot learn from others' experiences. We formulate Federated Recommender Agents, a setting where local agents collaborate through natural-language knowledge while keeping interaction histories and personal memories local. We propose FedRecAgent, which enables this collaboration without updating LLM parameters. Its central challenge is determining which reasoning to integrate, since similar behavioral contexts can lead to different choices. FedRecAgent represents local experiences as Condition-Transition-Reasoning (C-T-R) units and hierarchically integrates reasoning by condition and transition. Within this structure, it consolidates related explanations and discriminates reasoning across alternative transitions. Each client maintains semantic and decision memories to capture preferences and conditional choice tendencies, guiding the retrieval and selection of shared reasoning for recommendation. Experiments across three domains under dense and sparse settings demonstrate improved recommendation performance over federated and LLM-based baselines, while ablations support the contributions of personalized memories and structured reasoning integration.

papers.title_en: MRC-MMAgent: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Role Collaboration in Multimodal Tool-Using Agents
papers.authors: Shengqin Wang, Jie Jin, Xiaofan Li, Wentao Yan, Yu Cheng, Qingsong HuYihang Chen, Weilin Luo, Jingyu Gong, Xin Tan, Yuan Xie, Zhizhong Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向工具使用智能体的多角色协作强化学习
papers.tldr: 多模态工具智能体依赖外部检索解决复杂问题，但现有强化学习多训练单一求解角色，难以优化证据审查与答案修正。MRC-MMAgent将求解、检查和继续求解纳入可执行闭环，并以角色耦合目标联合优化所有角色的完整交互轨迹。仅使用原有基线训练集，该方法便持续优于对应基础模型，在多个基准上取得领先或有竞争力的表现。其贡献在于将自我纠错从附加步骤转化为可联合学习的决策过程。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal tool-using agents augment vision-language models with access to external information and capabilities, enabling them to solve knowledge-intensive and visually complex tasks that cannot be addressed using visual context alone. However, existing reinforcement learning pipelines largely train single-role agents to search and answer using terminal rewards, overlooking how humans inspect retrieved evidence, reformulate queries, and revise conclusions during search. Consequently, they fail to optimize this self-corrective process over complete interaction trajectories. We propose MRC-MMAgent, a multi-role collaborative reinforcement learning framework that incorporates trajectory assessment and continuation directly into the executable agent loop. First, the framework establishes a multi-role collaborative loop that integrates solving, inspection, and continuation, enabling the agent to acquire evidence through tools, evaluate the preceding trajectory, and resume problem solving when the current answer is insufficiently supported. Second, we introduce a role-coupled learning objective that combines task success, interaction validity, and successful correction with full-trajectory policy optimization across the decisions generated by all roles. Extensive experiments show that, using only the original baseline training set without constructing additional datasets, our method consistently outperforms the corresponding base models and achieves leading or highly competitive performance across benchmarks.

papers.title_en: From Artifacts to Coordination: Exploring How Shared Canvases Drive Collaboration during Group Ideation
papers.authors: Saramsh Gautam, Andrew M. Webb, Mahmood Jasim
papers.evidence: 通过用户研究考察共享画布交互如何支持群体协作
papers.tldr: 共享画布为群体构思提供灵活空间，但成员如何借助空间布局持续发展想法并协调任务，仍缺乏深入理解。研究让七个三人小组使用无限画布规划旅行行程，结合访谈与交互录像分析协作过程。结果发现，成员并行贡献、自由摆放素材，借此隐式协调，让较少发言者的贡献可见，区分个人探索区与共享工作区，并逐步形成角色分工。研究据此提出设计方向：呈现未被注意的贡献，支持角色自然涌现，并在引入人工智能时保留清晰的空间线索。
papers.abstract_en: Recent years have seen a surge in tools that support collaborative ideation through shared canvases. While these canvases offer flexible workspaces, how collaborators leverage them to iteratively develop ideas by externalizing thoughts, organizing artifacts, and coordinating tasks remains underexplored. To address this gap, we conducted an exploratory study with seven triads planning a travel itinerary using an infinite-canvas technology probe. Drawing on participant interviews and video analysis of their canvas interactions, we observed that collaborators contributed in parallel and arranged artifacts freely without a predefined structure. This spatial organization allowed collaborators to coordinate implicitly, made less vocal participants' contributions visible, helped distinguish private exploratory regions from shared working areas, and supported the emergence of distinct roles through repeated patterns of contribution. We discuss design implications for canvas-based ideation tools, including surfacing unnoticed contributions, supporting emergent roles without formalizing assignments, and keeping spatial cues legible for AI integration in collaborative canvases.

papers.title_en: MPBRS: Multi-Potential-Based Reward Shaping for Unified Reward Configuration in Humanoid Locomotion
papers.authors: Van Chung Nguyen, Hung Manh La
papers.evidence: 基于潜势的奖励塑形可迁移至强化学习奖励设计，但研究场景是机器人运动。
papers.tldr: 人形机器人强化学习依赖奖励设计，传统塑形项容易偏离目标行为，且对机器人形态和权重变化敏感。论文提出多势函数奖励塑形方法MPBRS，通过势函数差分引导探索，在不改变最优策略的前提下统一奖励配置。在九款人形机器人上复用相同奖励结构和权重，仅需提供关节与连杆映射、默认姿态等元数据。实验显示，相比标准奖励塑形，该方法的缩放表现更一致、调参敏感性更低，为跨机器人复用奖励设计提供了路径。
papers.abstract_en: Designing and tuning reward functions remains one of the main challenges in building effective reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines for humanoid locomotion. While shaping rewards can accelerate learning, naively formulated terms often conflict with the desired behavior, overfit to a specific robot, or become unstable under small weight changes. Potential-Based Reward Shaping (PBRS) offers an alternative solution: shaping the reward via differences of a potential function to guide exploration without changing the optimal policy. In this paper, we study Multi-PBRS for humanoid locomotion and propose a unified reward configuration. We then evaluate the same reward structure and weights across nine humanoid robots, requiring only robot-specific metadata (joint/link mappings and default poses) rather than per-robot reward redesign. Our experiments show that, compared to standard shaping, MPBRS provides more consistent scaling behavior and reduced tuning sensitivity across robots, making it easier to tune without altering the optimal policy.

papers.title_en: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
papers.authors: Yebo Feng, Jingyang Dai, Liangrui Pan, Nelson Lau, Jiahua Xu, Yang Liu
papers.evidence: 自主多智能体系统利用共享记忆和防护机制执行投资决策
papers.tldr: 自主投资智能体须整合不可信网页证据、记忆决策并从结果中学习，同时避免自我修改削弱安全约束。Steward以九个专业智能体、七层共享记忆和受确定性门控的反思更新协作，将订单计算、风控规则及纪律提示隔离为不可修改核心。五个月实盘中，面对板块24.6%的回撤，系统亏损为0.3%；回测中，核心在全部50种随机入场策略下降低最大回撤。研究展示了受治理的自我改进路径，但尚不足以证明长期超额收益。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents that act on live Web data must combine heterogeneous evidence, remember what they have done and improve from outcomes without weakening their own safeguards. We study this problem in autonomous investing, where every action is irreversible and based on untrusted Web content. We present Steward, a multi-agent LLM system that draws the boundary of self-evolution in its type system. First, nine role-specialised agents decide jointly: four analysts read news feeds, SEC filings, macroeconomic series and market data and emit typed reports, from which a Portfolio Manager sets target positions that a protected Risk Manager audits. Second, a seven-layer shared memory, assembled by code from the system's own record, gives each decision its position context, the market narrative, calibration and the agent's past decisions. Third, the system improves itself by review: code grades every trade and forecast nightly and writes the grades into memory, and each quarter a reflector proposes prompt learnings that a deterministic gate applies reversibly and replay of recorded inputs verifies. All three operate around an invariant core of order arithmetic, risk rules and discipline-agent prompts that no self-edit can reach. In a five-month live deployment (102 trading days, 1,632 LLM calls), the system contained a 24.6% sector drawdown to a 0.3% loss; in replay of its recorded inputs, a single model given the same raw data traded more and lost 1.35 points against the market over five days where the joint design showed no significant loss, and no injected instruction was followed; and a 2015-2026 backtest shows the core alone lowering the maximum drawdown under all 50 random entry policies. The reflector traced the dominant failure to its root cause, and the gate applied a learning that the agent adopted on trigger evenings and on no control evening. Code: https://github.com/yebof/quant-agent

papers.title_en: When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement
papers.authors: Hao Chen, Yukun Yan, Ziyu Han, Ye He, Chuanzhe Guo, Shangzhan Li, Qi Shi, Qingfu Zhu, Maosong Sun, Wanxiang Che
papers.evidence: 研究管理智能体交互、记忆与工具执行的框架
papers.tldr: 智能体可通过优化交互、记忆与工具执行框架持续改进，但静态评价标准难以追踪不断变化的行为弱点，可能限制泛化。论文提出RuHarness，让评价准则与执行框架协同演化，从执行轨迹中持续发现、重估并优先处理尚未解决的关键弱点，同时保持任务目标不变。跨多类任务和基座模型的实验显示，该方法优于强框架演化基线，在未见任务上尤其突出。结果表明，动态更新改进依据有助于维持多轮提升与稳定泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents increasingly depend on harnesses that govern interaction, memory, tools, and execution around large language models (LLMs). While recent work has begun to evolve these harnesses from execution experience, the supervision used to guide evolution often remains relatively static, making it difficult to track changing behavioral weaknesses across rounds and potentially limiting generalization to unseen tasks. To address this issue, we propose RuHarness, a rubric--harness co-evolution framework for continual agent self-improvement. RuHarness continually discovers and reassesses behavioral criteria from execution trajectories, prioritizes the most relevant unresolved weaknesses, and uses them to guide targeted harness updates while keeping the task objective fixed. Extensive experiments across diverse agent tasks and backbone models show that RuHarness outperforms strong harness-evolution baselines, particularly on unseen held-out tasks. Further analyses show that adaptive rubric prioritization tracks shifting weaknesses and supports more sustained improvement and stable generalization across evolution rounds.

papers.title_en: Aligning Institutional Power and Operational Ability
papers.authors: Andrea Marino, Giovanni Sileno, Thomas van Binsbergen, Tom van Engers
papers.evidence: 分析智能体责任、权限与执行能力之间的规范对齐
papers.tldr: 智能体系统若只规定责任与权限，却不核对实际执行能力，可能出现无法履行的义务、无法行使的权利或权限提升。本文围绕规范与能力对齐，提出结合流程导向建模和制度性权力的形式化框架。该框架用于分析具有规范意义的流程、识别设计不一致并讨论修复策略，同时阐释操作流程与制度状态的双向关系如何影响规范地位的生命周期。研究为多智能体系统的责任配置与治理提供分析基础，摘要未报告实证验证。
papers.abstract_en: To be socially sustainable, Agentic AI systems require normative designs that align responsibilities with the ability to fulfil them. Identifying incongruences such as unsatisfiable expectations or privilege escalation is crucial in avoiding normative pitfalls. In this study, we discuss design dimensions suitable for describing multi-agent systems in light of this norm-ability alignment requirement. We propose a formal framework centred on process-oriented modelling and institutional power for the analysis of a given normatively relevant process, discuss strategies for repairing it, and elaborate on how the symmetrical relation between operational process and institutional state affects the lifecycle of normative positions.

papers.title_en: When AI performs, what remains? An integrative review of generative AI and cognitive capital in individuals and organizations
papers.authors: Giuseppe Riva, Stefania La Rocca, Brenda K. Wiederhold, Andrea Gaggioli
papers.evidence: 综述生成式人工智能对组织中人类知识、判断与能力的长期影响。
papers.tldr: 生成式人工智能提升知识工作效率，但长期使用后，人和组织还能保留多少知识、技能与判断力，尚不清楚。本文以“认知资本”为框架，整合实验、实地与概念研究，区分人机协作表现与人类自身能力。综述提出练习替代、支架与反馈、元认知校准、组织聚合四类机制，指出绩效提升可能伴随能力流失，个体获益也可能伴随集体多样性下降。研究据此提出可检验命题和待验证的组织设计建议，为人工智能治理提供跨层级视角。
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence is rapidly entering knowledge work, and its short-term productivity benefits are increasingly documented. Less is known about what happens, over time, to the knowledge, skills and judgment that remain in people and organizations. This integrative narrative review addresses that question through the construct of cognitive capital: the accumulated, renewable and depletable stock of knowledge, cognitive and metacognitive capabilities, and practices that enables an individual or an organization to learn, interpret information, exercise judgment, solve problems and adapt. We distinguish individual and organizational cognitive capital from the capability of the human-AI system, so that gains in joint performance and losses in human capability can be observed at the same time. Drawing on experimental, field and conceptual work, we propose four mechanisms through which interaction with AI affects cognitive capital: substitution of practice, scaffolding and feedback, metacognitive calibration, and organizational aggregation. Seven principles summarize the current evidence, including that assisted performance differs from retained competence, that the same technology can support or displace learning depending on design and use, and that individual gains can coexist with reduced collective diversity. For each mechanism we derive testable propositions, and we discuss five design levers for organizations as proposals to be validated rather than established practice. We conclude that cognitive capital offers a multilevel frame for governing AI adoption and outline a research agenda centered on longitudinal, multilevel measurement.

papers.title_en: Event2Reward: Learning Robotic Rewards from Progress Relations
papers.authors: Junnan Nie, Zitian Fan, Jiachen Zhang, Junyi Lao, Likui Zhang, Chenghao Liu, Xiaoyang Lu, Yunbo Wang, Yixue Zhang, Linbo Zhai, Jiayi Li, Mengzhe Wang, Xichang Wu, Bin Wang, Chang Liu, Tianle Zhang, Songfang Huang
papers.evidence: 从相对任务进展关系中学习密集奖励，用于机器人强化学习。
papers.tldr: 机器人奖励学习常将示范时间视为任务进度，却容易把探索中的停滞和倒退误判为进展。Event2Reward结合归一化时间标签与轨迹内停滞、倒退、恢复事件的相对进度关系，学习用于奖励塑形的进度势函数。在四组LIBERO共40项任务上，策略平均成功率较稀疏奖励基线提高18.16个百分点；真实机器人训练30分钟后，两类任务成功率达60%和90%。该方法无需逐帧绝对进度标注，即可利用次优与失败执行改善奖励学习。
papers.abstract_en: Learning task progress from robot demonstrations provides a practical way to construct dense shaping rewards for robotic reinforcement learning. A common approach uses normalized demonstration time as progress labels, implicitly assuming monotonically increasing task progress. During policy exploration, however, actual task progress can stall or even regress. Such models may mistake regressions for progress, assigning positive shaping rewards to actions that cause progress loss. Real suboptimal and failed executions offer corrective experience, but assigning absolute progress values to their states is difficult. Our key observation is that stalls, regressions, and recoveries establish local relative progress relations even when absolute progress is unknown. We introduce Event2Reward, which uses normalized temporal labels to anchor the progress scale and these within-trajectory relations to constrain local changes, combining absolute and relative progress supervision. Its progress predictions serve as potentials for reward shaping. We curate an event-annotated dataset from approximately 100K raw real-robot execution records, covering successful, suboptimal, and failed executions, without requiring framewise absolute progress labels. Under the same training budgets, Event2Reward improves average policy success by 18.16 percentage points over a baseline using only sparse task rewards across 40 tasks in four LIBERO suites. On real robots, average success after 30 minutes of wall-clock training reaches 60.0% on three precise insertion tasks and 90.0% on three object manipulation tasks, exceeding the sparse-reward baseline under the same budget by 36.7 and 23.3 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies further show that absolute progress supervision and relative progress relations are complementary, with joint supervision yielding better downstream policy learning.

papers.title_en: Lookover: Scaffolding Student Participation in Social Annotation
papers.authors: Yubo Zhou, Xinyi Xu, Zesen Zhao, Anhong Guo, Xinyue Chen
papers.evidence: 通过社交批注促进学生参与和实质性同伴互动
papers.tldr: 社交批注平台虽能通过必评要求促进参与，却未必形成持续、深入的同伴交流。研究分析一门研究生课程六周的2873条评论，并结合访谈设计Lookover：用讨论概览帮助定位主题和讨论串，用启发式提问支持学生深化回应，而不代写评论。原始数据中53.5%的评论无人回复，38.3%集中在截止前12小时发布；五人初步研究显示，概览对注意到它的参与者有价值，提问效果则取决于已有知识。研究为兼顾讨论导航与思考支持提供了设计方向。
papers.abstract_en: Social annotation platforms such as Perusall and Hypothesis are widely used to support student engagement with course readings, often through required commenting. Yet visible participation does not necessarily produce sustained or substantive peer exchange. Analyzing six weeks of Perusall activity from a graduate course (2,873 comments), we found that participation was often fragmented: 53.5% of comments received no reply, 38.3% were posted within the final 12 hours before the deadline, and over one-third of a double-coded sample went no further than repeating or agreeing with the reading or a peer. Interviews pointed to two linked difficulties: locating a discussion worth entering and contributing something that meaningfully advances it. We present Lookover, an AI-assisted annotation system that scaffolds both stages without writing for students. Discussion Overview helps students identify active themes and relevant threads, while Spark Thinking poses questions that encourage them to move beyond reaction and restatement toward questioning, extending, and substantively responding to peers. A preliminary study with five participants found Discussion Overview valuable for those who noticed it, while the usefulness of Spark Thinking depended on how much a participant already knew about the topic.
